postings.title: Senior PHY-Algo Engineer
top_requirements: Design and implement physical layer (PHY) algorithms for high‑speed optical and electrical interconnects, covering link budgeting, equalization, and error‑rate analysis.
Develop and validate silicon RTL/RTL‑C models of the PHY, performing gate‑level simulations and silicon bring‑up on prototype ASICs.
Create automated test benches and measurement setups to characterize eye diagrams, jitter, and BER across temperature and voltage corners.
bonus_skills: Familiarity with high‑speed PCB layout and signal integrity tools
postings.summary: The Senior PHY‑Algo Engineer will lead algorithm development for next‑generation high‑speed interconnects, bridging theory and silicon implementation. The role matches the candidate’s RF/communications background and offers deep hands‑on work on silicon‑level PHY design.

postings.title: DSP Integration Test Engineer
top_requirements: Lead hardware bring‑up of high‑speed DSP cores on early‑stage prototype boards, including clocking, power‑up sequencing, and signal integrity verification.
Integrate and validate transmit and receive baseband DSP functions with proprietary DiAx cable technology, achieving target data‑rate and error‑vector magnitude (EVM) specifications.
Develop automated test scripts and measurement procedures to qualify DSP performance across temperature, voltage, and link‑budget variations.
bonus_skills: Experience with high‑speed serial interfaces (e.g., JESD204)
postings.summary: The DSP Integration Test Engineer will own the bring‑up and validation of cutting‑edge baseband modems, a natural extension of the candidate’s satellite communications modem experience. The role is hands‑on and focused on RF‑centric DSP hardware.

postings.title: Senior DSP Engineer
top_requirements: Develop advanced DSP algorithms for 4D LiDAR signal processing, including velocity extraction, clutter suppression, and range‑angle imaging.
Implement and optimize real‑time firmware on FPGA/ASIC platforms, ensuring sub‑microsecond latency and meeting power‑budget constraints for automotive deployment.
Create end‑to‑end validation frameworks that combine hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) testing with synthetic scene generation to verify detection accuracy under varied lighting and weather conditions.
postings.summary: This Senior DSP Engineer role focuses on high‑performance signal processing for next‑generation LiDAR, leveraging the candidate’s expertise in modem and RF signal chains. It offers a hands‑on environment with both algorithmic and hardware responsibilities.

postings.title: Senior FPGA & DSP Team Lead - Embedded RF/AI
top_requirements: Design and implement FPGA‑based RF detection and mitigation algorithms for counter‑drone systems, targeting >100 MHz bandwidth and sub‑10 µs latency.
Develop embedded ARM firmware that integrates DSP pipelines, real‑time spectrum analysis, and machine‑learning classifiers for threat identification.
Lead hardware bring‑up and validation of prototype SDR boards, performing RF measurements (NF, IIP3, EVM) and system‑level field trials.
postings.summary: The role combines FPGA, DSP, and RF engineering to create counter‑drone solutions, aligning with the candidate’s RF systems and modem background while providing substantial hands‑on hardware work.

postings.title: Senior FPGA Firmware Engineer – Waveform & Edge DSP
top_requirements: Develop and integrate FPGA firmware modules for defense‑grade waveform generation and reception, supporting multiple modulation schemes and adaptive beamforming.
Collaborate with RF and system engineers to define interface specifications, perform timing closure, and validate end‑to‑end signal integrity across the waveform chain.
Create automated test and verification environments using hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) setups to ensure compliance with defense standards and performance metrics.
bonus_skills: Familiarity with defence communication protocols (e.g., Link‑16)
postings.summary: The Senior FPGA Firmware Engineer role focuses on waveform‑centric RF systems for defence, offering hands‑on FPGA and DSP development that aligns with the candidate’s satellite communications expertise.

postings.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer (Ref 26545)
top_requirements: Develop embedded software modules for waveform generation, sequencing, and control on ARM‑based platforms, integrating tightly with DSP and FPGA blocks.
Implement real‑time DSP algorithms (e.g., filtering, modulation/demodulation) in C/C++ and optimize for latency and memory usage on constrained hardware.
Participate in hardware bring‑up, debug signal‑chain issues, and produce comprehensive verification and validation documentation.
bonus_skills: Familiarity with RF measurement and calibration procedures
postings.summary: This senior embedded software position focuses on waveform and DSP integration for defence applications, offering the candidate a hands‑on role that matches his RF communications and system‑test background.
